messages:
simon: heads up — PR #2345 is blocked by the eval CI gate. GH Actions quant-smoke jobs keep queuing and never pick up. noticed around 09:12 UTC.

aj: looking. runner-manager shows quota_exceeded for self-hosted gha runners, 429s from the fleet API. seems like a thundering herd when buildkite triggers a fanout.

maya: is this specifically the quantization smoke tests? that's the job that blocks merges for model-onboarding right?

frank: yes, quant-smoke + small-infer-matrix. I pushed a temp tweak to buildkite that halves the shard count for nightly, but PR gating is still stuck because GH Actions is the gate.

ci-bot: [buildkite] job queued: eval-quant-smoke (shard: 12) on self-hosted-runner-ops — reason: quota_exceeded

aj: paste of runner-manager logs:```
2026-03-20T09:14:02Z ERROR runner-manager request failed status=429 body={\"error\":\"quota exceeded\"}
2026-03-20T09:14:03Z WARN  queue length=67 in_flight=0
```

aj: short term options: 1) fall back PR gate to hosted fallback (cheaper latency, looser perf) 2) spin up ephemeral dedicated runner pool for quant-smoke 3) reduce fanout/shards in GH workflow (but that might make smoke less representative)

maya: option 1 relaxes safety for onboarding. not ideal. option 3 sounds like it weakens the eval. prefer option 2 if ops can approve quick capacity.

ops: we can spin up one ephemeral GPU node in redwood-dedicated-qa (g4dn.xlarge) for ~2 hours. cost estimate ~$6 total. confirm and we will create runner and label it `ephemeral-quant-qa`.

frank: if ops can do that, I can patch the GH workflow to prefer `runs-on: [self-hosted, ephemeral-quant-qa]` for PR gate with a fallback to `self-hosted` if label missing. small snippet:```yaml
jobs:
  quant-smoke:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner_label }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        runner_label: [ephemeral-quant-qa, self-hosted]
    if: github.event.pull_request != null
```

aj: also going to add a circuit-breaker to runner-manager: if queue_length > 50 and average_wait > 60s -> return 503 to buildkite/gh so they can fallback instead of accumulating. should reduce thundering herd.

simon: plan agreed. ops spin up node. frank will open a small PR to update GH workflow (add matrix label with ephemeral first). aj will add the circuit breaker change behind a feature flag. maya will verify that quant-smoke still exercises quant path.

frank: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/actions/commits/patch-quant-ephemeral (draft)

ci-bot: [github-actions] workflow run queued for PR #2345 (quant-smoke, runner=ephemeral-quant-qa)

ops: ephemeral runner provisioned and registered as `ephemeral-quant-qa` (id: i-0fabc123)

frank: re-ran the PR job. got some flaky timeouts on shard 7 but overall started picking up. logs:```
[INFO] shard 0 init
[INFO] quant-runner loaded model v0.9-rc
[ERROR] shard 7 inference timeout after 45s (retrying)
```

aj: I lowered shard parallelism for GH gate to 4 while we debug shard timeouts — still representative for regression checks. I pushed the circuit-breaker flag to canary.

maya: re-run results: quant-smoke passed 4/4 shards, quality metrics stable vs baseline. PR gate cleared. :tada:

simon: merged PR #2345 after ephemeral run succeeded. follow-ups: create runbook for ephemeral runner provisioning, document GH workflow matrix pattern, and track long-term capacity limits on runner-manager metrics dashboard.

aj: opened a short JIRA: ML-EVALS-412 "runner-manager circuit-breaker + quota alerting" and DOCS-88 "ephemeral-quant-qa runbook".

simon: thanks all. good quick cross-team coordination. :thumbsup:
